svg.aria-label: Dueproof. Every deadline in your notices, proved on the page. Dueproof reads tax, regulatory and court notices, finds what's owed and by when, and proves every finding on the page it came from. A sample GST notice has one sentence highlighted: pay the tax of Rs. 4,52,300 with interest within 30 days of receipt of this notice. A line links it to a card: reply due 23 Nov 2026, 30 days from receipt on 24 Oct 2026, computed by the date engine.

g.text: v0.1.0 BETA / INDIA FIRST / SELF-HOST FREE
Dueproof reads tax, regulatory and court notices, finds
what's owed and by when, and proves every finding on the
page it came from. A person decides; code computes every date.
You are hereby directed to explain the
discrepancies and pay the tax of Rs. 4,52,300
with interest within 30 days of receipt of
SAMPLE NOTICE: FICTIONAL OFFICE, REFERENCE AND COMPANY
